## G.5 Partner portal (`Partners` workspace; channels C and D)

The partner portal is the `Partners` workspace rendered in the operations portal (Udofin side) and in the lender portal (RE side) on the same records, with side-specific actions. Borrowers see nothing of a lender before the deal reaches `PILOT`.

| Path | Udofin side (C) | RE side (D) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Partners › Deals` | Pipeline board with ageing chips and filters; deal tabs Overview, Gates, Due diligence, Configuration, Pilot, Reviews, Events, Audit trail; **New deal**; **Advance** (lists each failing gate item with a fix link), **Suspend**, **Withdraw**, **Start exit**; society deals add the eligibility checklist, name check, rule pack, counsel opinion and bulk **Re-verify** | Same deal record; countersign queue; RE approver roles from the outsourcing policy | UP1, UP4 |
| `Partners › Due diligence` | Udofin pack builder, counter-party checks, expiry calendar, bulk **Request refresh** | RE questionnaire inbox, declarations to sign (DSC or Aadhaar eSign) | UP1 |
| `Partners › Configuration` | Versions, twelve-section editor with explain-why validation, diff, impact panel, synthetic-borrower simulation; **Validate**, **Submit for approval**, **Send to RE**, **Schedule**, **Roll back**; U2 product approvals sit in the products and scope section | **Countersign**, **Reject with reasons**; export of any version as JSON plus PDF | UP2; U2 |
| `Partners › Exports` | Failure queue with **Retry on same snapshot**; operations view of schedules | Pack catalogue and **Request pack** wizard (pack → period → scope → masking → approver → channel); history with **Verify** | UP3 |
| `Partners › Exit` | Exit detail with borrower-position table, notice templates, export hashes; **Suspend**, **Lift suspension**, **Approve plan**, **Mark disputed**, **Issue destruction certificate** | **Approve plan**, acknowledgements, data-return receipt | UP5 |
| `Partners › Members` | Not shown | Society staff only: membership verification queue, membership applications with the deemed-refusal countdown, members' loan applications with committee references | UP4; MG1 |

`Tenants` (lender class, activation), `Users and roles` (RBAC and attribute scopes, maker-checker, MFA), `Feature flags` (gate-controlled flags show their gate and cannot be forced on), `Themes` (contrast checks), `Credentials vault`, `Security monitoring`, `Break-glass` (time-boxed, dual approval, reported to the affected RE), `Audit trail`. | Menu | Screens and key actions | Rules |

| `Datasets` | Dataset browser limited to the grant scope; field dictionary; record view masked by default; **Unmask** per record with typed reason (only where the grant allows `FULL`) | Scope banner (RE, grant ID, PII and export levels) and countdown on every screen; no write action exists |
| `Query` | Read-only query builder over the scoped datasets; saved queries; row limits | Every query logged and included in the RE's daily activity report |

## G.8 Field and assisted app (channel E)

Separate Expo app on managed devices (U22; MG4). Bottom tabs: **Today**, **Groups**, **Members**, **Collections**, **Me**.

| Path | Screens and key actions | States |
|---|---|---|
| `Today` | Centres due today with state chips, tasks, offline badge, last sync; **Start meeting** | "No centres today" |
| `Today › Meeting` | Attendance grid, collection sheet with per-member UPI QR, receipts (cash only where the RE's legal opinion is recorded), issues, **Close meeting** (disabled with explain-why while any receipt is unsynced or a conflict is open) | Offline: capture allowed; UPI needs connectivity |
| `Groups` | Group pipeline (`FORMING` to `ACTIVE`), roster with household and guardrail status, **Add member** (assisted wizard), **Schedule CGT**, **Schedule GRT** (GRT picker excludes the CGT trainer) | GRT FAIL: group returns with reasons |
| `Members` | Search within allocated centres; **Assisted onboarding** (staff-device steps; consent, KFS acceptance and eSign on the member's own device while the agent sees "waiting for member"); SHG linkage wizard | No mobile: MG4.4 route only where the RE allows |
| `Collections` | Sheets, receipts, unsynced items; `› Recovery cases` only where Udofin or its agency is the appointed agent (UR4): particulars status, `canContact` result, outcomes, PTP, check-in on the agent's device, digital receipts | No delivered particulars notice: actions locked |
| `Me` | Device status, last sync, sync batches (`QUEUED`, `UPLOADING`, `ACCEPTED`, `CONFLICT`, `REJECTED`), digital ID and authorisation letter, logout, remote-wipe notice | Clock drift over 5 minutes: sync blocked with instructions |

Agents never see or enter an OTP, give consent, accept a KFS, sign, choose a lender, or change a member's bank or contact details (MG4.2). No contacts, SMS, call-log or storage permissions; camera, coarse location for staff check-in and notifications only.

## G.10 Settings catalogue

### G.10.1 Hierarchy and resolution

| Level | Set by | Change control | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| L0 Platform floor | Code and regulatory rule packs | Release only; legal-review layer (Part 3.4) | No contacts or SMS permission; cooling-off at least 1 day; no ranking keys |
| L1 Udofin | Udofin compliance, product, risk or finance | Maker-checker; effective-dated | Forwarding target 1 hour; signed-URL validity |
| L2 RE deal | UP2 configurator | Udofin legal sign-off for sections 4, 7, 8, 9, 10; RE countersign | Pricing model, KRI tightening, recovery and DLG options |
| L3 Product | `product_offer_version` (U2) | RE publication plus Udofin approval | Cooling-off period, KFS template, microfinance window |
| L4 Channel | Feature flags (U23) | Platform-approved configuration | Store filters, society gate on A, web transaction limits |
| L5 User | Borrower or staff member | Self-service with step-up where sensitive | Contact window, language, marketing choices |

**Resolution rules.**

1. Each setting has a `nature`: `FLOOR` (minimum; lower levels may only tighten), `CEILING` (maximum; lower levels may only lower), `FIXED` (no override), `HARD_BLOCK` (the feature does not exist in the schema), `GATE` (on only when its evidence exists), `COMMERCIAL` (most specific level wins within the range above), `USER_CHOICE` (applies within the product and channel bounds; never relaxes a floor).
2. Effective value = L0, then each lower level in order; the validator rejects a value that relaxes a `FLOOR` or `CEILING` and cites the basis. Between two sources at one level (for example Udofin and RE GRC KRIs), the stricter wins.
3. Each record is a versioned, effective-dated `module_setting` (key, level, scope, value, nature, basis, effective_from, effective_to, version, maker, checker, reason) with an impact preview for scheduled changes; `GET /settings/effective` returns the value and its resolution trace.
4. `GATE` settings cannot be set by hand; they follow their gate records.

### G.10.2 Consolidated key settings

Cross-module and high-impact settings only; module-specific settings (for example pack, archive and download links, rollout steps, attachment limits) stay in each module's `Settings and options` table under the same resolution rules.

## G.11 Notification catalogue

### G.11.1 Classes and channel rules

| Class | Examples | Consent | Sender and numbers | Quiet hours | Borrower can switch off? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Security | OTP, new device, contact change, original download, data export generated | Not required (account protection) | Udofin DLT header; OTP templates carry the SMS Retriever hash and origin-bound line (Part 10.3) | Exempt | No |
| Transactional (borrower-triggered) | Payment initiated, application submitted, KFS accepted, eSign completed | Inferred from the action | RE header for RE matters; Udofin header for platform matters | Exempt (sent at the time of the action) | No |
| Service (lifecycle) | Due reminders with penal charge, KFS awaiting acceptance, document issued, complaint updates, cooling-off ending | Service relationship while the contract lasts | RE header and the RE's 1600-series voice numbers for RE matters | Default 21:00–08:00 [REC]; regulatory deadlines may be sent at 08:00 next day | Channel choice only; at least one channel stays on |
| Recovery | Overdue reminders, agent particulars, settlement offers, RE notices (content only in the authenticated inbox) | RE contract and CF para 9(6) | RE header and RE 1600-series numbers only; no WhatsApp | 08:00–19:00 (RBC para 100); microfinance 09:00–18:00 until 31 Dec 2026 (RBC para 91(2)), then the RBC Third Amendment pack from 1 Jan 2027 (RBI/2026-27/230); narrower RE or borrower window wins | No (statutory and contractual), but the borrower sets a preferred window |
| Promotional | Udofin campaigns, non-loan products, plan offers | Explicit promotional consent per channel, default No; DND scrub | Udofin promotional header; 140-series voice through a registered telemarketer | 09:00–18:00 [VERIFY: final para 101O]; XP4 suppression reasons | Yes, one tap |

**Common rules.** Every SMS uses a TRAI DLT-registered header and content template under the correct principal entity and category (TCCCPR 2018; header suffix by category as TRAI requires [VERIFY: current suffix rule]); URLs only on the DLT-whitelisted domain [VERIFY]; push, SMS and email carry no PII, amount or case content where the event is sensitive (recovery, grievance, notices, credit reports); every message is in the borrower's chosen language from an RE-approved template for RE matters (RBC para 10); RE service calls never use ordinary 10-digit numbers; Udofin's own outbound service calls stay off until 1600-series eligibility is confirmed (RA5). Frequency: no persistent calling; promotional messages at most 2 per week per channel [REC].

### G.11.2 Event catalogue

| Trigger (event or timer) | Message | Class | Channels | Sender and notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Login; new device bound; contact change | OTP; "A new device was added" with **Not me** | Security | SMS; email and push to other devices | Udofin; DPS para 68(6) baseline |

| `KFSIssued`; 1 working day before validity ends | KFS ready, "valid until [date]"; one reminder | Service | Push, SMS, email | RE template; no urgency language |
| `ESignCompleted`, `EStampCompleted` | Execution complete; RE-signed pack delivered | Transactional | Email; SMS link | RE, or Udofin on its behalf (CF para 9(3)) |
| `MandateRegistered` or failure | AutoPay status and next step | Service | Push, SMS | RE template |
| `LoanDisbursed`, `DisbursementFailed` | Amount and date, cooling-off end date and exit right; or the RE's next step | Service | SMS, push, email | RE template; cooling-off display starts (Part 5.2) |
| Cooling-off: 1 day before end | "You can still exit until [date]" | Service | Push, in-app | Udofin for [RE name] (CF para 11) |
| `DueReminderTrigger`, `ScheduleChanged` | Pre-due reminder with amount, date and penal charge; change of terms | Service | Push, SMS, WhatsApp (never recovery), email | RE template (RBC paras 15, 30) |
| `PaymentReceived`, `PaymentBounced` | RE receipt available; bounce with the RE's charges and options | Transactional or service | Push, SMS, in-app | RE; Udofin's acknowledgement reads "payment initiated" until the receipt |
| `DPDChanged` (overdue) | Overdue reminder linking to the authenticated centre | Recovery | SMS, push (no amount), in-app | RE template; windows and caps per G.11.1 |
| `CollectionAllocated` | Agent particulars before first contact | Recovery | SMS and email | RE or Udofin on its behalf; hard gate (CF para 9(6)); from 1 Jan 2027 at least 1 day before a visit (para 100L) [VERIFY] |
| `LegalNoticeIssued`; `SettlementOfferIssued` and 2 days before its validity ends | "You have a new notice from [RE name]"; offer available | Recovery | In-app, SMS link, email; push without content | "Delivered by Udofin, LSP of [RE name]"; never "served"; no false urgency |
| `ADRHearingScheduled` | Hearing date; reminder at least 3 days before | Service | Push, SMS, email | Udofin for [RE name] (UR2) |
| `GrievanceRaised`, `GrievanceUpdated`, `GrievanceEscalated`; external window 30, 14 and 3 days before close (opt-in) | Reference; forwarding, reply and escalation updates; window reminders | Transactional or service | In-app; push and SMS without content | Udofin (UB3) |
| `DocumentShared`, `NOCIssued`, `InterestCertificateIssued`; document-release clock day 25 | Document available; status of original documents | Service | Push, email, SMS | Udofin for [RE name]; download needs step-up (RBC para 35) |
| Original downloaded; data export generated | Account-takeover alert | Security | All registered channels | Udofin; cannot be switched off |
| `LenderDealSuspended`, `LenderDealTerminated` | RE-approved continuity notice; download end date 15 days before it ends | Service | Email, SMS, in-app | RE text (UP5) |

| `PolicyIssued`; free-look 5 days before expiry; renewal 30 and 7 days before | Policy and reminders | Service | Push, email, SMS | Udofin with insurer documents (XP2) |
| Campaigns and non-loan offers | Promotion | Promotional | Consented channels only | Udofin; suppressed during overdue, recovery, hardship, open grievance, cooling-off and 30 days after a microfinance disbursal |

## G.14 IPB-07 settings-tree mapping *(v1.3)*

The binding 20-node IPB-07 tree (§07.4.2) is mapped to Appendix G. Node names and order are binding; a node the product does not need is hidden by role, never removed (IPB-DEV-01). Settings keys follow the IPB prefixes; Udofin's `module_setting` records (G.10.1) keep their levels and natures and are rendered under the node named here. Regulatory floors stay non-configurable regardless of node.

### G.14.1 Borrower app and web (channels A, B) — `Account › Settings`

| # | IPB node | Udofin path (A, B) | Contents (existing → mapped; new in bold) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
